id.description: Unique id, `<name>-<source>`. Also the thumbnail filename.

style.description: A style URL or an inline MapLibre style object.

thumbnail.description: An image's name in your project's `basemap-images/` folder (or the catalog's, `widgets/basemap/assets/basemap-images/`), or an image URL. Omit to use the image named after the basemap's id.
